title: MV PS1-style cover mockup I made for my RPG Maker MV game!

posts.author: guihguih27
posts.body:
Just wanted to share a little mockup I made for fun — a PS1-style cover for my RPG Maker MV project, Crônicas de Terralux. I was messing around with some visual ideas and ended up really liking how this turned out
I tried to capture the look and feel of old PlayStation RPGs, with a minimalist composition and a mysterious figure in the background — in this case, a character from the game called Protectia.
P.S: This mockup is heavily inspired by classic Final Fantasy PS1 title screens. It’s meant as a tribute and a stylistic choice, so if that’s a problem for you, this might not be the right thread to follow. Thanks for understanding!
